summary: Contrasts the "document" point of view, where digital objects are like pieces of paper read by people, with the "protocol" point of view, where objects are dynamic network messages. It argues that sticking to the document view can damage protocol design and that understanding both helps avoid conflicts.

eli5.summary: A letter is made to be read by a person, but a message between computers is more like a plug that must fit exactly. Designing one as if it were the other causes trouble.

questions: document versus protocol point of view
why protocol design differs from document design
